content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High external agent exec rate detected against inference pool us-west-2-gpu-pool-3. CPU and queue latency rising — paging on-call.

maya-oncall: ACK. Paging @jamie-sre and @rachel-eng. Spinning up ops bridge.

jamie-sre: I’m on it. Traces show external action executions spiked ~7x in last 3m, tied to large structured JSON responses. Top noisy tenants: playground-cli, free-tier-bot.

jamie-sre: Short-term mitigation (live):
- Block external action execution via exec-proxy for non-enterprise tenants.
- Force compact/text-only output mode for streaming & inline responses.
- Emergency per-tenant rate limits: action_exec = 1 r/s, generation = 5 r/s.
- Trim structured payloads: max_structured_size = 512 bytes.
- Increase shedding threshold on very long KV sessions.

jamie-sre: Pushing config patch (rollback-safe):
```json
{
  "exec_proxy": { "block_external_actions": true, "exceptions": ["enterprise-"] },
  "response_format": { "default_mode": "compact", "max_structured_size": 512 },
  "ratelimits": { "action_exec_per_tenant": 1 }
}
```

ops-bot: `patch-deploy` started for service inference-config (build 2026.3.45). Rolling to us-west-2-pool-3.

rachel-eng: Observability: CPU hotpaths point to JSON serializer overhead when structured payloads > 2KB. Compact mode and size cap should drop tail latency and CPU.

leo-support: Drafting customer comms now. Subject suggestion: "Temporary limitation on external integrations and structured outputs — mitigation in progress". Will include tenants affected and ETA (re-eval in 1h).

jamie-sre: Patch is live on pool-3. Early telemetry: latency p95 down ~40% in first 2m, queue length dropping. Still watching error budget and downstream timeouts.

maya-oncall: Good work. @leo-support hold until we confirm error budget stable, then publish. Tag customers with >5% error increases.

rachel-eng: Follow-up items: add per-tenant backpressure for actionexecs, size-aware structured-output throttling, and a warning metric when serializers exceed threshold.

jamie-sre: Handoff in 30m to @rachel-eng for continued monitoring and postmortem. Bridge remains open; ops-bot will escalate if SLO delta > 5% for 10m.

incident-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/incident/4032101234

leo-support: Status posted to status.redwood.com/incidents/4032101234 — internal notes added.

rachel-eng: Acknowledged. Will own postmortem; will create a task for unit + integration tests for structured-output gating and an RFE for graceful actionexec throttling.

maya-oncall: Moving to monitoring. If we see another spike, re-pager. Thanks all.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from jamie-sre, rachel-eng, leo-support)
